description: This file implements project-related services and business logic for a backend system, including project creation, listing, detail retrieval, updating, deletion, and project member management, utilizing SQLAlchemy for database access and FastAPI for HTTP exceptions.

methods.name: Project _ensure_project_access(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Ensures that the specified user has access to the project, either as owner or member, and returns the project if accessible.

methods.name: Project create_project(db: AsyncSession, owner: User, name: str, description: Optional[str], visibility: str)
methods.description: Creates a new project with the specified owner, name, description, and visibility.

methods.name: List[Project] list_projects_for_user(db: AsyncSession, user_id: int)
methods.description: Lists all projects where the user is either owner or a member.

methods.name: Project get_project_detail(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves project details if the user has access.

methods.name: Project update_project(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int, updates: dict)
methods.description: Updates project fields if the user has sufficient permissions.

methods.name: None delete_project(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a project; only the owner can perform this action.

methods.name: ProjectMember add_or_update_member(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, actor_id: int, target_user_id: int, role: str)
methods.description: Adds or updates a project member; actor must be owner or admin.

methods.name: None remove_member(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, actor_id: int, target_user_id: int)
methods.description: Removes a member from the project; actor must be owner or admin.
